# Setup

```{r libs}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(glue)

stopifnot(packageVersion("patchwork") >= "1.2.0")
```

```{r config}
CFG <- list(
  data_path = "OptimalGrowthCurves.xlsx",
  fig_dir   = "figures",
  res_dir   = "results",
  metric    = "OD600",

  strains = c(
    "B.infantis"         = "B. infantis",
    "B.longum"           = "B. longum",
    "B.bifidum"          = "B. bifidum",
    "B.breve"            = "B. breve",
    "L.fermentum (supp)" = "L. fermentum"
  ),
  comparator = "L. fermentum",

  expected_times = list(
    "B.infantis"         = c(0, 8, 24, 32, 48),
    "B.longum"           = c(0, 8, 24, 32),
    "B.bifidum"          = c(0, 8, 24, 32, 48),
    "B.breve"            = c(0, 18, 24, 32, 48),
    "L.fermentum (supp)" = c(0, 8, 24, 32)
  ),
  expected_reps = c("B.infantis" = 4, "B.longum" = 3, "B.bifidum" = 3,
                    "B.breve" = 3, "L.fermentum (supp)" = 3),

  endpoint_h = 24,
  conf_level = 0.95,

  strain_cols = c(
    "B. infantis"  = "#3B75AF",
    "B. longum"    = "#519E3E",
    "B. bifidum"   = "#8D69B8",
    "B. breve"     = "#C53A32",
    "L. fermentum" = "#9E9E9E"
  ),
  cond_cols = c("Reduced oxygen" = "#3B75AF", "Aerobic" = "#CA6627"),
  cond_lty  = c("Reduced oxygen" = "dashed",  "Aerobic" = "solid"),
  ribbon    = "SEM",

  time_breaks = c(0, 8, 24, 48),
  time_limits = c(0, 48),
  fold_breaks = c(1, 10),
  fold_minor  = c(0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 2:9, 20),
  fold_limits = c(0.55, 22),

  fig_w_mm  = 183,
  fig_h_mm  = 150,
  base_size = 9
)

COND_LEVELS   <- names(CFG$cond_cols)
STRAIN_LEVELS <- unname(CFG$strains)
dir.create(CFG$fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(CFG$res_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r helpers}
# Sheets differ in header layout; locate the condition row rather than
# hard-coding positions. Replicate numbers are used where labelled,
# otherwise column order.
read_strain_sheet <- function(path, sheet) {
  txt <- suppressMessages(read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, col_names = FALSE,
                                     col_types = "text"))
  num <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
    read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, col_names = FALSE, col_types = "numeric")))

  cond_row <- which(apply(txt, 1, function(r) any(r %in% "Anaerobic")))
  stopifnot("exactly one condition header row" = length(cond_row) == 1)

  cond <- unlist(txt[cond_row, ], use.names = FALSE)
  cond[1] <- NA
  for (j in seq_along(cond)[-1]) if (is.na(cond[j])) cond[j] <- cond[j - 1]
  od_cols <- which(cond %in% c("Anaerobic", "Aerobic"))

  time_rows <- which(!is.na(num[[1]]) & seq_len(nrow(num)) > cond_row)
  stopifnot("no data rows found" = length(time_rows) > 0)

  lab_rows <- if (min(time_rows) - cond_row > 1)
    seq(cond_row + 1, min(time_rows) - 1) else integer(0)
  rep_lab  <- if (length(lab_rows) == 1)
    unname(unlist(num[lab_rows, od_cols])) else NULL
  labelled <- !is.null(rep_lab) && !anyNA(rep_lab)
  rep_id   <- if (labelled) rep_lab else
    ave(seq_along(od_cols), cond[od_cols], FUN = seq_along)

  tibble(
    sheet     = sheet,
    time_h    = rep(num[[1]][time_rows], times = length(od_cols)),
    condition = rep(cond[od_cols], each = length(time_rows)),
    replicate = rep(as.integer(rep_id), each = length(time_rows)),
    OD600     = as.vector(as.matrix(num[time_rows, od_cols]))
  )
}

p_star <- function(p) {
  case_when(is.na(p) ~ "",
            p < 0.001 ~ "***", p < 0.01 ~ "**", p < 0.05 ~ "*",
            TRUE ~ "n.s.")
}

fold_lab <- function(x) paste0(x, "\u00D7")

theme_pub <- function(base = CFG$base_size) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "italic", size = base + 1),
      legend.key.width = unit(10, "mm"),
      plot.tag         = element_text(face = "bold", size = base + 6),
      plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 4)
    )
}

save_fig <- function(plot, name, w_mm, h_mm, out_dir = CFG$fig_dir) {
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
  ok <- tryCatch({
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
           width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm",
           device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (!ok) ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
                  width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm")
  invisible(plot)
}
```

# Data

```{r read}
missing_sheets <- setdiff(names(CFG$strains), excel_sheets(CFG$data_path))
if (length(missing_sheets))
  stop("Sheets not found: ", paste(missing_sheets, collapse = ", "))

od <- map_dfr(names(CFG$strains), ~ read_strain_sheet(CFG$data_path, .x)) %>%
  mutate(strain    = factor(CFG$strains[sheet], levels = STRAIN_LEVELS),
         condition = recode(condition, "Anaerobic" = "Reduced oxygen"),
         condition = factor(condition, levels = COND_LEVELS))

for (s in names(CFG$strains)) {
  d <- filter(od, sheet == s)
  if (!isTRUE(all.equal(sort(unique(d$time_h)), CFG$expected_times[[s]])))
    stop(s, ": unexpected timepoints")
  if (any(count(distinct(d, condition, replicate), condition)$n != CFG$expected_reps[[s]]))
    stop(s, ": unexpected replicate count")
}
stopifnot(
  "missing OD values"  = !anyNA(od$OD600),
  "non-positive OD600" = all(od$OD600 > 0),
  "duplicated cells"   = !anyDuplicated(od[c("strain", "time_h", "condition", "replicate")])
)

# A whole timepoint row repeated in two strains indicates a copy-paste error
dup_rows <- od %>%
  filter(time_h > 0) %>%
  arrange(strain, time_h, condition, replicate) %>%
  group_by(strain, time_h) %>%
  summarise(sig = paste(sprintf("%.6f", OD600), collapse = "|"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sig) %>% filter(n() > 1) %>% ungroup()
if (nrow(dup_rows)) stop("Identical timepoint rows in two strains; check for copied rows")

od %>% count(strain, condition, name = "n_obs")
```

# Descriptives

```{r descriptives}
desc <- od %>%
  group_by(strain, condition, time_h) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(OD600), sd = sd(OD600),
            sem = sd(OD600) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(err = if (CFG$ribbon == "SEM") sem else sd)

write.csv(select(desc, -err),
          file.path(CFG$res_dir, glue("{CFG$metric}_descriptives.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)
desc
```

# 24 h endpoint tests

Two-sided one-sample t-test of paired ln(reduced oxygen/aerobic) OD600 ratios
against 0 at `r CFG$endpoint_h` h; effect reported as the geometric-mean ratio
(GMR) with 95% CI. Pairing uses replicate number (labelled in the B. longum and
B. bifidum sheets, column order elsewhere).

```{r endpoint}
pairs <- od %>%
  filter(time_h == CFG$endpoint_h) %>%
  select(strain, replicate, condition, OD600) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = OD600) %>%
  mutate(ratio = `Reduced oxygen` / Aerobic)
stopifnot(!anyNA(pairs$ratio))

write.csv(pairs,
          file.path(CFG$res_dir, glue("{CFG$metric}_pair_ratios.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

stats_tbl <- pairs %>%
  group_by(strain) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    tt <- t.test(log(.x$ratio), mu = 0, conf.level = CFG$conf_level)
    tibble(n        = nrow(.x),
           gmr      = exp(unname(tt$estimate)),
           ci_lower = exp(tt$conf.int[1]),
           ci_upper = exp(tt$conf.int[2]),
           t        = unname(tt$statistic),
           df       = unname(tt$parameter),
           p_value  = tt$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(stats_tbl,
          file.path(CFG$res_dir, glue("{CFG$metric}_statistics.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

stats_tbl <- mutate(stats_tbl, stars = p_star(p_value))
stats_tbl
```

# Sensitivity

Unpaired Welch t-test on ln(OD600), in case replicate numbers do not identify
matched cultures; and Holm adjustment of the primary p-values across the four
Bifidobacterium strains.

```{r sensitivity}
welch <- od %>%
  filter(time_h == CFG$endpoint_h) %>%
  group_by(strain) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    ro <- log(.x$OD600[.x$condition == "Reduced oxygen"])
    ae <- log(.x$OD600[.x$condition == "Aerobic"])
    tt <- t.test(ro, ae, var.equal = FALSE, conf.level = CFG$conf_level)
    tibble(analysis = "Welch unpaired t-test",
           gmr      = exp(mean(ro) - mean(ae)),
           ci_lower = exp(tt$conf.int[1]),
           ci_upper = exp(tt$conf.int[2]),
           p_value  = tt$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

holm <- stats_tbl %>%
  filter(strain != CFG$comparator) %>%
  transmute(strain,
            analysis = "Paired t-test, Holm-adjusted p",
            gmr, ci_lower, ci_upper,
            p_value  = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm"))

sens <- bind_rows(welch, holm) %>% arrange(strain, analysis)

write.csv(sens,
          file.path(CFG$res_dir, glue("{CFG$metric}_sensitivity.csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

sens %>% mutate(stars = p_star(p_value))
```

# Figure

```{r figure, fig.width = CFG$fig_w_mm / 25.4, fig.height = CFG$fig_h_mm / 25.4}
a_dat  <- stats_tbl %>% mutate(strain = factor(strain, levels = rev(STRAIN_LEVELS)))
a_pts  <- pairs     %>% mutate(strain = factor(strain, levels = rev(STRAIN_LEVELS)))
a_star <- a_dat %>%
  left_join(a_pts %>% group_by(strain) %>% summarise(pmax = max(ratio)), by = "strain") %>%
  mutate(x = pmax(ci_upper, pmax) * 1.12)

pA <- ggplot(a_dat, aes(y = strain, colour = strain)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = ci_lower, xend = ci_upper, yend = strain), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = a_pts, aes(x = ratio), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_point(aes(x = gmr, fill = strain), shape = 23, size = 2.6,
             colour = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = a_star, aes(x = x, label = stars), hjust = 0, vjust = 0.3,
            colour = "black", size = CFG$base_size / .pt) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = CFG$fold_breaks, labels = fold_lab,
                minor_breaks = CFG$fold_minor, limits = CFG$fold_limits,
                expand = expansion(0)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = CFG$strain_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CFG$strain_cols, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = expression("Fold difference in "*OD[600]*" at 24 h (reduced oxygen/aerobic)"),
       y = NULL) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = CFG$base_size + 1))

pB <- ggplot(desc, aes(time_h, mean, colour = condition, fill = condition,
                       linetype = condition, group = condition)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean - err, ymax = mean + err), alpha = 0.18,
              colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  annotate("segment", x = -Inf, xend = -Inf, y = -Inf, yend = Inf,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 1.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ strain, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = CFG$time_breaks, limits = CFG$time_limits,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = CFG$cond_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CFG$cond_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = CFG$cond_lty, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Time (hours)", y = expression(OD[600])) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.spacing.x = unit(5, "mm"))

fig_growth <- (pA / free(pB)) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.15)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

save_fig(fig_growth, "growth", CFG$fig_w_mm, CFG$fig_h_mm)
fig_growth
```
